note: A captures the sheet's key technical specs that B omits entirely: the 18'-0" solar envelope height, the 40-tube count for the 2 X APSE-20 collectors, and the 1/8" steel cable railing (material plus cable diameter). B is more careful with the window tags, correctly typing 1.07/1.06/1.02 as identifiers where A mislabels them as "dimension", and B also records both drawing scales. Both sets invent a PV-array grid-line location that the page does not state and both repeat the finished-floor, grade-level and handrail facts several times. On balance A's coverage of the substantive envelope, collector and railing facts outweighs its two misbound tag claims.

remarks: Both sets miss POWDERCOATED STEEL FLATBAR RAILING POSTS, the D1/W5/W6 door and window marks, and General Sheet Note 2 (spacing may be larger between solar thermal tube arrays; necessary valves and piping not shown) and Note 3 (dotted lines = door swing, layered swing lines = tilt and turn) - note 2 is a real design condition. The PV-array grid-line location claimed by both sets is not resolvable from the text layer and only weakly from the image, so both claims are treated as unsupported; if the drawing does place one array over grids 4-5 or 4-6, that claim should be re-scored. Text layer contains the typo "TONNGUE"; A silently corrected it in one claim while quoting the misspelling.
